sg-001: “Come in. I am told you read people well. Tell me what you see in the faces outside.”
sg-002: “I do not keep idle advisers. You have until the inspection ends to prove you are not one.”
sg-003: “Ride behind me, and do not speak unless you must. Ask your question when the horses rest.”
sg-004: “You came a long way to knock on a hermit's door. State your business plainly.”
sg-005: “You brought the river charts? Good. Show me the bend that worries you.”
sg-006: “Everyone wants me for their banner. Tell me why I should want yours.”
sg-007: “Walk slowly. In this corridor even the silence has listeners. What do you wish to ask me?”
sg-008: “Stay low and stay close. Tell me what you saw on the ridge.”
